responsibility: Defines the legacy macro-driven master list of rs6000 builtins consumed directly by backend source through repeated macro inclusion. It categorizes scalar, AltiVec, VSX, HTM, MMA, predicate, and special builtins by arity, assigns each an enum name, user-visible __builtin_* spelling, enabling mask bits, attribute flags, implementation insn code, and compatibility aliases, serving as the old-style builtin registry that rs6000-call.c and related code use to declare, initialize, and recognize PowerPC builtins.
